items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Dave Weckl’s another guy that . . . Fantastic young players.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. He’s a fantastic drummer. Man. Talking about being mad at somebody. I’m going to break his hands. Because to me, those guys are a full rhythm section within themselves. It used to be, I played the samba and things like that, I had three other guys helping me. Now these guys play a clavé beat with the left foot, and the right foot’s doing something different, and the other hand – he’s fantastic.
How about – coming up in age, looking at David Weckl?
